directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an advertisement on your campus website to sell some of the course books you used at college. Your advertisement may include a brief description of their content,their condition ,their price and your contact information. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Are you looking for high-quality course books at an affordable price? Look no further! I'm selling some of the course books I used during my college years.

To begin with, these books cover a wide range of subjects, including mathematics, literature, and computer science. For instance, the math book has detailed explanations of complex formulas and numerous practice problems. In addition, all the books are in good condition. Although they have some highlighting and marginal notes, which can actually help you better understand the key points, the pages are intact and not torn.

Furthermore, the prices are extremely reasonable. Each book is priced between 10 and 30 yuan, depending on its thickness and popularity. You can get a great deal compared to buying brand-new ones.

If you're interested, please contact me at 123456789 via text or call. Don't miss this opportunity to get useful course books at a low cost!
